item.title: ZT Community Combined dll File (LANG--ZTCDD.dll)
item.description: This file contains messages that are meant to be used by multiple sites in the community, either for ztd files that are put at multiple sites or for messages that are reused for different ztd files at different sites. Many messages in it are used by the downloads at the Designer’s Guild (DG) site, which is a site where designers from multiple sites meet, along with at the Designer’s Directory (DD) site.

item.title: LangZA03.dll
item.description: LangZA03.dll consolidates and replaces several dll files, updating building messages and resolving conflicts for Zoo Admin releases up to January 2020.
